largeAboutMe: My first 'Hello world' was the blinking LED of an Arduino, and since then I've focused on orchestrating complex systems and transforming strategic ideas into resilient digital architectures.

I share Steve Jobs' idea that 'design is not just how it looks, but how it works,' applying it to both the user interface and the underlying software architecture. I find the balance where complex engineering feels seamless and high-performing.
I believe the web should be accessible, sustainable, and scalable, focusing my role on high-level technical decisions that ensure long-term stability.
I value every detail in the system's lifecycle because I know it's those small architectural decisions that make the difference between something that just works and a system built to scale.
shortAboutMe: Full-Stack Developer & Software Architect 🇨🇺 specialized in designing high-level technical strategies and orchestrating systems that endure from end to end.
marketingAboutMe: Over 1.5 years contributing to the web have taught me that good development isn't measured only in code, but in the experience it creates.
I am a Web Developer specialized in building that for you: the platform that showcases your work, attracts clients, and operates without you worrying about the technology.
From an impactful landing page to a complete online store, I build solutions that not only work but feel incredible and are ready to grow with your business.
